segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: several say it does not dry them out further and even helps hydration, but one with eczema-prone dry skin reports a flare-up and breakouts, and one says it left her face still tight after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report the cleanser as gentle, non-irritating and non-drying, though one describes severe redness like sunburn and a couple mention mild redness or a burning sensation in the first days.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combined oily/dry skin says it worked well for her and for her daughter's acne-prone skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes it helps with the oily part of her skin and reduces breakouts, though this is the only mention specific to oily skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports fewer fine lines with regular use, but this is an isolated observation rather than a recurring theme.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the gel cleans without leaving skin dry or tight, and several with dehydrated or dry skin report improved hydration and softness; a few describe their skin as drying, tight, or requiring a moisturizer afterward, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports significant irritation and sunburn-like redness that recurred on a second try, and another mentions temporary redness or a burning sensation that faded within a day; many others report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: An eczema-prone reviewer reports a flare-up and breakouts after use, suggesting the product is not suited to compromised or reactive barriers, while most other reviewers with sensitive skin report no adverse reaction.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading or reduced dark spots and hyperpigmentation with regular use, but two reviewers say it did not lessen their sunspots or old acne dark marks.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some note fewer blackheads or clearer skin over time, but one describes tiny blisters after two days and one notes it did not help with acne.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes it manages the oily part of her combination skin, but oiliness is rarely discussed.

extraits.texte: I rarely write reviews but I need to let anyone that has eczema skin to stay away from this cleanser. Not only did it not clean my face well it flared up my eczema and caused breakouts as well (I am dry skinned). Just no.

The scent is neutral, the consistency is gentle. But it didn't work for my skin at all. It left my skin soft but super irritated, red as if I'd been sunburned. I thought it was because of the hot water, so I gave it another try and the same thing happened; my skin became more irritated. It may be a good product, but not for sensitive skin.

I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Cleansing Gel as a free sample in exchange for my review. Overall I liked this cleanser. There is very subtle scent that is not lingering which I think is important in face wash. It washes off clean and did not leave my skin feeling dry or tight. I have occasionally sensitive skin and I did not have any breakouts or adverse reactions to this wash. I'm not sure how much brighter or radiant my skin is after using this but I still find it to be a good product.

I've been using the Eucerin Radiant Tone Cleansing Gel for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed! As someone with sensitive skin prone to uneven tone and occasional dullness, finding a cleanser that's both effective and gentle has always been a challenge. What I love most is how thoroughly it cleanses without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. Many cleansers leave my face feeling tight and dry, but this one leaves it feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. The gel texture is light and lathers nicely, making it a pleasure to use both morning and night. I've also noticed a subtle but definite improvement in my skin's overall radiance. My complexion looks brighter and more even, and those pesky little dull patches are starting to fade. It's not a dramatic transformation overnight, but a gradual and healthy-looking improvement.

extraits.titre: Great product but pump broke off right off the bat
extraits.texte: Been using the Eucerin Radiant Gel facial wash and the Eucerin Radiant Dark Spot Serum together now for a month. The Eucerin products have worked really well on my hyperpigmentation. Over half of the dark spots have vanished and the remaining spots have faded considerably. Just bought a second bottle of the serum. However the pump on the Radiant Gel Wash to dispense the gel has broken off when I first used it. I wrestled with pump to force it back on but it will fall out again when I next use it making it very inconvenient to use - very frustrating.
This is great for my skin which is combined oily/dry and my daughter's acne prone skin.

4 Stars – Great Cleanser, But a Bit Drying I've been using the Eucerin Radiant Tone Cleansing Gel for a few weeks now, and overall, I really like it! It lathers up nicely and leaves my skin feeling super clean without any heavy residue. My complexion looks brighter, and I've noticed a subtle glow, which is a huge plus! The only downside is that it can be a little drying, especially in the winter. I make sure to follow up with a good moisturizer, and that helps a lot. If you have super dry skin, you might want to use it every other day instead of daily. Overall, it's a great addition to my skincare routine—gentle, effective, and really helps with dullness!
